newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHALKE BEAT TENERIFE TO REACH FIRST EUROPEAN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE BEAT TENERIFE TO REACH FIRST EUROPEAN FINAL.

text.p: Schalke of Germany beat Tenerife 2-0 after extra-time in the second leg of their UEFA Cup semifinal on Tuesday to reach a European final for the first time in their history.

A header from defender Thomas Linke, who rose in the 68th minute to power the ball past the Spanish side's Swedish goalkeeper Beng Andersson, took the tie into extra-time before Belgian striker Marc Wilmots headed a second in the 107th minute to secure a 2-1 aggregate margin.

The Gelsenkirchen team deserved their win, showing more invention and applying more and more pressure as the match went on. Their first goal came from their 15th corner while the visitors had managed just one.
